description:
Suhyun, dumped by his boyfriend for drinking too much, signs up for a wave tour in hopes of meeting his destined partner. But even the man he meets in Paris ends up leaving him! With nothing but heartbreak left behind, the only comfort Suhyun finds in Paris is wine. The next morning, after indulging a little too much, Suhyun wakes up to a pounding hangover—and a mysterious handsome stranger waiting for him…
